title: Best Ps5 Pro (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Sources used: TechRadar, PCWorld, IGN, Tom's Hardware, CNET, Wired.
assumptions: No price information is provided in the sources, so price caveats are omitted.

verdict.line: Picture a gamer who wants the best graphics and smoother frame rates; the PS5 Pro delivers higher fidelity and improved ray tracing compared to the standard PS5, making it the top choice for those who value visual performance. The main catch is its high price and lack of a disc drive.
